He also happens to be a GM Monk, so Monks may train their skills by right clicking him if they want to.

=== Strategy ===
Although Brother Z doesn't enrage or rampage, he is a stiff tank and spank that requires an Enchanter + Cleric duo, or similar power level trio/group. He is very magic resistant so don't bother slowing him. He regenerates about 300/tick.
